purpose: Verified contract for displaying citizen-understandable source lineage for material property legal-life answer claims.
claim_rule: Material claims retain an identifiable supporting source or approved evidential basis.
scope_rule: Displayed sources are tied to the specific proposition, record or procedure they support.
property_rule: Property-specific claims retain property matching where material.
temporal_rule: Historical claims retain relevant date/version context.
case_law_rule: Case law is shown only for the proposition actually supported.
guidance_rule: Official guidance is distinguished from legislation.
limitation_rule: Source limitations and access restrictions remain visible when material.
verification_boundary: Provenance display explains source lineage; it does not create new facts, legal conclusions or confidence scores.
